Sam (Sales): EuroBank wants an air-gapped POC in their FRA DC. They asked for details on packaging, upgrade cadence, signed bundles, and an offline pricing delta. Can we list blockers and a short runbook they can expect?
Alex M.: For packaging: we provide an immutable, signed bundle + optional delta bundles for patches. Delivery options: USB / secure transfer / customer jumpbox.
Priya S.: Important: customer-managed KMS or HSM required for key custody in most finance deals. We can support: local HSM integration or pre-signed bundles if they insist on no KMS connectivity.
Jorge R.: Upgrade cadence recommendation: quarterly minor (nonbreaking) updates, monthly security patch window for critical CVEs. For air-gapped, hotfixes come as signed delta bundles that apply on top of the baseline.
Sam (Sales): What's the mechanism for applying deltas offline? Any tooling we give them?
Alex M.: We ship a tiny operator + apply tool. Typical flow: provision baseline image, then run `redwood-apply --bundle signed-delta.tar.gz` on the admin jumpbox. Tool verifies signature and checksum before applying.
Alex M. (cont): Example verification snippet we share with customers:
```
# verify checksum
sha256sum signed-delta.tar.gz
# verify signature (cosign example)
cosign verify --key cosign.pub signed-delta.tar.gz
```
Priya S.: Also include a manifest with SBOM metadata and a signature block. We recommend HSM-backed signing on our side for production images, but for POC we can use a delegated signing key.
Maya (SecOps Bot): Security checklist items to attach to the SOW: 1) Signed image provenance 2) SBOM + SBOM verification 3) Offline key custody plan 4) Audit log export method (sideload) 5) Emergency rollback procedure 
Sam (Sales): Pricing question from the customer: is there a separate charge for air-gapped delivery / signing / USB shipping?
Alex M.: Yes — we generally charge a one-time airgap packaging fee + per-PoC engineering hours. Also an optional recurring premium for extended offline support (24x7 + on-call escalation) if they want an SLA.
Jorge R.: For scope: if they want a zero-trust offline update path (signed deltas + HSM rotation), that usually pushes them into the Enterprise SOW (adds ~2-4 weeks of eng + security review).
Priya S.: Additional blocker: network egress exceptions. If they refuse any outbound egress, we need explicit acceptance of the manual update cadence and no remote telemetry. That affects observability and costs.
Sam (Sales): Ok — customer also asked about rollback. How easy is it to roll back a delta?
Alex M.: Deltas are designed to be reversible if the operator kept the pre-update snapshot. Our operator supports automatic snapshot/rollback when run against supported storage. We note that for certain model quant bundles, rolling back may need a rebootstrap if KV cache formats change.
Maya (SecOps Bot): Attach file: `security-items-checklist.pdf` (we'll add to the doc package). Also flag: legal needs the offline data handling addendum signed.
Sam (Sales): Anything else that would block go/no-go for FRA DC PoC?
Jorge R.: Hardware compatibility matrix (GPUs + driver versions) — must be validated pre-PoC. Also kernel modules for the operator — some locked-down environments require signed kernel modules.
Priya S.: Recommend we ask them to fill the short questionnaire: `HSM present? (Y/N)`, `Can you accept signed telemetry manifests?`, `Preferred media (USB/Jumpbox)`, `Retention for SBOMs`.
Sam (Sales): I'll send them the questionnaire and estimate: one-off packaging $8k, engineering integration (SOW) est 40-80 hrs, optional premium support +$3k/month. Will follow up with legal for addendum.
Alex M.: Ping me for technical SOW details and I'll draft the update/runbook. :thumbsup:
Priya S.: I'll prepare HSM integration checklist and sample manifest to include.
Maya (SecOps Bot): Noted. Created ticket SEC-AG-412 for the addendum review.
Sam (Sales): Great — thanks team. I'll update the customer and post back with their answers.
Jorge R.: If they push for faster cadence (weekly), flag that it increases engineering churn significantly. Keep an eye on requested SLAs.
Sam (Sales): Will do. Thanks all.
